defect_summary: Tag-time ./release graded containment on a local release/v0.7.0 that was behind origin, and reported NOT_MET while origin already contained main.
unsuitable_process: nlc_release_context.main_context diffs origin/main against the local release/v* name. When origin/release/v* exists and is ahead, that local tip is the wrong input. ADR 0049 main_context is the ship line, which is origin when the remote-tracking ref exists.
climb_steps: ./release printed BLOCKED_MAIN_CONTEXT_NOT_CONTAINED on a stale local.
Containment is graded before FAST_FORWARD_LOCAL when relation is behind.
ADR 0049 main_context must reflect the release line being shipped.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
